fullPassage: One well-known shift took place when the accepted view — that the Earth was the center of the universe — changed to one where we understood that we are only inhabitants on one planet orbiting the Sun. With each person who grasped the solar system view, it became easier for the next person to do so. So it is with the notion that the world revolves around the human economy. This is slowly being replaced by the view that the economy is a part of the larger system of material flows that connect all living things. When this perspective shifts into place, it will be obvious that our economic well-being requires that we account for, and respond to, factors of ecological health. Unfortunately we do not have a century or two to make the change. By clarifying the nature of the old and new perspectives, and by identifying actions on which we might cooperate to move the process along, we can help accelerate the shift.

det.korean: '전치사 + 관계대명사(on which)'로 앞 명사 actions를 꾸며 주는 구조
det.analysis:
'우리가 (~에 대해) 협력할 수 있는 행동들'은 '명사 + 전치사 + which + 주어 + 동사'로 만들어요.

① 꾸밈을 받는 명사 actions(행동들)를 먼저 써요.

② '~에 대해 협력하다'는 cooperate on ~이라, 전치사 on을 관계대명사 which 앞으로 보내 'on which'로 이어요.
